files.note: Complete: all 210 pages read. The book is organised as four topic blocks (Cytology pp.1-73, Blood pp.74-115, Connective Tissue pp.116-164, Epithelium pp.165-210). Each block runs titled teaching plates, then an explicit test divider (p.32 'DATA SHOW MODEL EXAM', p.89 'BLOOD - Trial test', p.138 'Test', p.184), then question/answer plate pairs on consecutive pages. Pages 69, 88 and 184 carry no recoverable caption at 120, 300 or 400 dpi and are recorded as caption-less rather than guessed. Pages 77, 79 and 80 were illegible at 120 dpi and were resolved by a 300-400 dpi retry (Neutrophil, Eosinophil, Basophil). Page 85 prints a third-party image source URL, recorded on that slide.
Data-show revision deck: odd pages pose a marked plate, the following page gives the model answer. Page 2 carries an Arabic notice from the department (transcribed under examNotices).
Numbered orientation atlas with printed keys; no exam stems present.
